hadi-march/ui#ICON_GROUPS.name: ICON_GROUPS
hadi-march/ui#ICON_GROUPS.value:
[
  { id: "arrows", label: () => t`Arrows`, match: /arrow|chevron|corner|undo|redo|refresh|rotate/i },
  { id: "files", label: () => t`Files`, match: /file|folder|archive|save|download|upload|clipboard|copy|book/i },
  { id: "media", label: () => t`Media`, match: /play|pause|step|music|video|image|camera|mic|volume|film|monitor/i },
  { id: "messages", label: () => t`Messages`, match: /mail|message|phone|bell|send|chat|inbox|share|at/i },
  { id: "people", label: () => t`People`, match: /user|heart|smile|thumb|award|star/i },
  { id: "layout", label: () => t`Layout`, match: /layout|panel|column|grid|sidebar|list|table|layers|maximize|minimize/i },
  { id: "filled", label: () => t`Filled`, match: (_n, d) => !!d.fill },
]
hadi-march/ui#ICON_GROUPS.tr: IconPicker süzgeç çiplerinin hazır listesi: oklar, dosya, medya, iletişim, kişi, düzen, dolu.

hadi-march/ui#IconButton.name: IconButton
hadi-march/ui#IconButton.doc: Icon-only button. `label` is required (aria-label + tooltip title). `<IconButton icon="✕" label="Close" onClick={…}/>` size: xs | sm | md | lg. variant: danger | solid | raised. `shape="round"`, `pressed` (toggle), `inverse` (on dark media), `href` (a link).

props.name: title
props.doc: The native tooltip: the label by default, your own text, or false for none.

props.name: shape
props.doc: `round`: a circle.

props.name: pressed
props.doc: A toggle button: sets `aria-pressed` and the shared pressed look (`is-pressed`). Leave unset for a plain button.

props.name: inverse
props.doc: On dark media (a photo, a video, a scrim): light icon, light hover and focus ring.

props.name: href
props.doc: Renders a link that looks like the button: the router's Link inside the app, a plain `<a>` for an external address.

props.name: children
props.doc: Shown after the icon (alone when there is no icon): e.g. a count Badge, which sits on the corner.

hadi-march/ui#IconButton.tr: Yalnızca simgeli düğme. `label` zorunludur (aria-label + ipucu başlığı). `<IconButton icon="✕" label="Close" onClick={…}/>`

hadi-march/ui#IconPicker.name: IconPicker

props.name: value
props.doc: The chosen icon's name (a signal, a value or an accessor); null: none.

props.name: icons
props.doc: The icons to choose from (default every built-in icon).

props.name: packs
props.doc: More icon sets, chosen above the grid and loaded when first chosen (or when the value names one).

props.name: setLabel
props.doc: The name of `icons` in the set list (default "March").

props.name: pageSize
props.doc: Icons drawn at once; scrolling to the end of the grid draws as many more (default 240).

props.name: groups
props.doc: The filter chips (default ICON_GROUPS); false: none.

props.name: inline
props.doc: The panel right in the page instead of behind a button (a sidebar, a form section).

props.name: none
props.doc: A "No icon" choice (default true).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the button and the panel (default "Icon").

hadi-march/ui#IconPicker.tr: Simge seçici: seçili simgeyi ve adını gösteren düğme; açılan panelde arama, süzgeç çipleri ve bütün simgelerin ızgarası (inline ile düğmesiz).

props.name: src
props.doc: Image URL (same origin, data: or blob:, so the canvas can read it).

props.name: alt
props.doc: Accessible description of the image.

props.name: aspect
props.doc: Fixed aspect (width / height); omitted: the aspect choices decide.

props.name: aspects
props.doc: Aspect choices (default free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, 3:4, 9:16); false hides them.

props.name: maxZoom
props.doc: Highest zoom (default 4).

props.name: preview
props.doc: A live preview of the result (default true).

props.name: api
props.doc: Receives the cropper API.

props.name: grid
props.doc: The rule-of-thirds grid inside the frame (default true).

props.name: hint
props.doc: The key hint under the crop area (default true); when false it stays readable for screen readers.

props.name: tools
props.doc: The buttons: true (default), false, or the ones to keep.

props.name: sliders
props.doc: The sliders: true (default), false, or the ones to keep.

props.name: size
props.doc: The "640 × 480 px" caption under the preview (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { cropper?: string; area?: string; role?: string; hint?: string; free?: string; aspect?: string; rotateLeft?: string; rotateRight?: string; mirror?: string; reset?: string; zoom?: string; angle?: string; result?: string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one. `role` is the crop area's role description, `hint` the key hint.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#initials.name: initials
hadi-march/ui#initials.doc: Initials for a name ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"), locale aware upper casing.
hadi-march/ui#initials.tr: Bir ad için baş harfler ("Ada Lovelace" → "AL"), dile uygun büyük harfe çevirme.

hadi-march/ui#inputFor.name: inputFor
hadi-march/ui#inputFor.doc: The component for a schema field (null for hidden fields).
hadi-march/ui#inputFor.tr: Bir şema alanının bileşeni (gizli alanlar için null).

hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.name: insertAfter
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.doc: Insert `value` after `p` (in an array) or after key `p` with `key` (in an object).
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.signature: function insertAfter(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, value: unknown, key?: string): unknown
hadi-march/ui#insertAfter.tr: `value` değerini `p`'den sonra (dizide) ya da `key` ile `p` anahtarından sonra (nesnede) ekler.

hadi-march/ui#isAction.name: isAction
hadi-march/ui#isAction.doc: Is the value an action() object?
hadi-march/ui#isAction.signature: function isAction(v: unknown): v is Action

hadi-march/ui#isMac.name: isMac
hadi-march/ui#isMac.doc: True on Apple platforms (⌘ is the primary modifier).

hadi-march/ui#isPicture.name: isPicture
hadi-march/ui#isPicture.doc: True for a picture object (`{ src }`), false for a node or anything else.
hadi-march/ui#isPicture.signature: function isPicture(x: unknown): x is PictureSource
hadi-march/ui#isPicture.tr: Değer bir resim nesnesiyse (`{ src }`) true, düğüm ya da başka bir şeyse false döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.name: isSafeLink
hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.doc: True for URLs safe to link: http(s), mailto, tel and relative ones (never javascript:, data:, vbscript: …).
hadi-march/ui#isSafeLink.tr: Bağlantı için güvenli URL'lerde true: http(s), mailto, tel ve göreli olanlar (asla javascript:, data:, vbscript: …).

hadi-march/ui#isSep.name: isSep
hadi-march/ui#isSep.doc: Is this menu entry a separator ("-" or `{ separator: true }`)?
hadi-march/ui#isSep.signature: function isSep(it: MenuItem): it is "-" | { separator: true }
hadi-march/ui#isSep.tr: Bu menü girdisi bir ayraç mı ("-" ya da `{ separator: true }`)?

hadi-march/ui#isUndeclared.name: isUndeclared
hadi-march/ui#isUndeclared.doc: A value is a name read before its declaration ran.
hadi-march/ui#isUndeclared.tr: Kayıttaki değer, bildirimi henüz çalışmamış (TDZ) bir ada mı ait.

hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.name: itemVisible
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.doc: Is this menu entry shown for `args` (action guard, `hidden`, `can` permission)?
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.signature: function itemVisible(it: MenuItem, args: unknown[]): boolean
hadi-march/ui#itemVisible.tr: Bu menü girdisi `args` için görünür mü (action koruması, `hidden`, `can` izni)?

hadi-march/ui#Joined.name: Joined
hadi-march/ui#Joined.doc: Parts as one piece: `<Joined><Preview /><CodeView … /></Joined>`. Whatever goes in loses its own border, corners, margin and shadow; the whole has one frame and one radius, and a line between the parts. `direction="horizontal"` side by side.

props.name: direction
props.doc: "vertical" (default: one under the other) or "horizontal" (side by side).

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius of the whole (default: the theme's radius, step 2); the parts have none of their own.

props.name: border
props.doc: The frame around the whole (default true).

props.name: dividers
props.doc: A line between the parts (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Joined.tr: Parçaları tek bir bütün gibi çizer: içine konan her şey kendi çerçevesini, köşesini, boşluğunu ve gölgesini bırakır; bütünün tek çerçevesi ve köşesi, aralarda çizgi; dikey ya da yatay.

hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.name: JsonEditor
hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.doc: JSON editor with a text and a tree view: `<JsonEditor bind:value={$data} mode="tree" schema={schema} />`. Value: the parsed JSON (null when empty); while the text is invalid the raw string.

props.name: validate
props.doc: Extra check of the parsed value → message or null.

props.name: schema
props.doc: JSON Schema subset (see TreeEditor): problems are listed in the text view and marked on the tree rows.

props.name: indent
props.doc: Format indent (2).

props.name: tabIndent
props.doc: Tab inserts two spaces (default true).

props.name: mode
props.doc: First view (default "text").

props.name: modes
props.doc: Views offered (default text and tree); one hides the switcher.

props.name: expand
props.doc: Tree levels open at start (default 2).

props.name: format
props.doc: The Format button under the text (default true).

props.name: status
props.doc: The "Valid JSON" confirmation under the text (default true). Problems are shown either way.

props.name: labels
props.type: { text?: string; tree?: string; view?: string; treeName?: string; fixFirst?: string; valid?: string; format?: string; invalid?: ((line: number | null, column: number | null, message: string) => string) | undefined; more?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one: the two views (`text`, `tree`), the switcher's name (`view`), the tree's name (`treeName`), the tooltip of the tree tab while the text is broken (`fixFirst`), `valid`, `format`, `invalid(line, column, message)` and `more(count)` ("+2 more" after the first schema problem).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#JsonEditor.tr: Metin ve ağaç görünümlü JSON düzenleyicisi: `<JsonEditor bind:value={$data} mode="tree" schema={schema} />`. Değer: ayrıştırılmış JSON (boşken null); metin geçersizken ham dize.

hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.name: jsxCompleter
hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.doc: `complete` for a `<Tag …>`: `jsxCompleter({ tag: "Button", props: [{ name: "variant", values: ["primary", "ghost"] }, { name: "icon", value: "={plus}" }] })`. `props` may be an accessor (the list can change). Without `tag` any opening tag is completed.
hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.signature: function jsxCompleter(o: { tag?: string | (() => string); props: readonly JsxProp[] | (() => readonly JsxProp[]) }): (ctx: CodeCompleteContext) => CodeCompletion | null

params.name: o
params.type: { tag?: string | (() => string); props: readonly JsxProp[] | (() => readonly JsxProp[]) }

hadi-march/ui#jsxCompleter.tr: CodeEditor için bir JSX etiketinin hazır `complete` işlevi: özellik adlarını ve tırnak içinde değerlerini önerir: `jsxCompleter({ tag: "Button", props: [{ name: "variant", values: ["primary", "ghost"] }] })`.

hadi-march/ui#key.name: key
hadi-march/ui#key.doc: Register a global shortcut. Returns an unregister function (also called automatically with the current owner). `combo` e.g. "mod+k", "/", "shift+?" ("g u" sequences are not supported; single chords only).
hadi-march/ui#key.signature: function key(combo: string, fn: (e: KeyboardEvent) => unknown, opts: KeyOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/ui#key.tr: Genel kısayol kaydeder. Kaydı kaldıran bir işlev döndürür (mevcut sahip ile otomatik de çağrılır). `combo` örn. "mod+k", "/", "shift+?" ("g u" dizileri desteklenmez; yalnızca tek tuş birleşimleri).

hadi-march/ui#KeyframeTimeline.name: KeyframeTimeline

props.name: renderTarget
props.doc: Draws a preview target (default: a labelled pill in the track's color).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Snap step in ms (default 50; 0 turns snapping off).

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Start playing when shown (default false).

props.name: loop
props.doc: Loop (default true).

props.name: stage
props.doc: Preview stage over the lanes (default true).

props.name: transport
props.doc: The playback bar: true (default), false, or the parts to keep. Space still plays and pauses.

props.name: speeds
props.doc: Speed choices (default 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2).

props.name: inspector
props.doc: The keyframe inspector under the lanes: time, value, delete, easing (default true).

props.name: hint
props.doc: The text shown in the inspector's place while no keyframe is selected (default true).

props.name: curves
props.doc: The value curve drawn in every lane (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { timeline?: string; playback?: string; play?: string; pause?: string; start?: string; loop?: string; speed?: string; playhead?: string; hint?: string; time?: string; value?: string; remove?: string; easing?: string; keyframe?: ((number: number, target: string, prop: string) => string) | undefined; lane?: ((target: string, prop: string) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one: `timeline`, `playback`, `play`, `pause`, `start`, `loop`, `speed`, `playhead`, `hint`, `time`, `value`, `remove`, `easing`, `keyframe(number, target, prop)`, `lane(target, prop)`.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#KeyframeTimeline.tr: Anahtar kare zaman çizelgesi düzenleyicisi: `<KeyframeTimeline bind:value={$timeline} />`.

hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.name: KeyValueEditor
hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.doc: Edit an object of string → string (or number with `numbers`). Rows keep their order; empty keys are skipped; duplicate keys are flagged. Props: keyPlaceholder, valuePlaceholder, numbers (numeric-looking values become numbers).

props.name: numbers
props.doc: Numeric-looking values become numbers.

props.name: labels
props.type: { key?: string | undefined; value?: string | undefined; remove?: string | undefined; add?: unknown; duplicate?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: `key` / `value` (accessible names and default placeholders), `remove`, `add` ("Add row"), `duplicate` ("Duplicate key").

props.name: removable
props.doc: The remove button of a row: `false` removes it.

props.name: addable
props.doc: The "Add row" button: `false` removes it.

props.name: removeIcon
props.doc: Content of the remove button instead of the "×" icon (a node, text or `() => node`).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#KeyValueEditor.tr: Dize → dize (`numbers` ile sayı) nesnesini düzenler. Satırlar sırasını korur; boş anahtarlar atlanır; yinelenen anahtarlar işaretlenir. Prop'lar: keyPlaceholder, valuePlaceholder, numbers (sayıya benzeyen değerler sayı olur) ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#Layout.name: Layout
hadi-march/ui#Layout.doc: The default Layout: back-to-top and route focus on. `features={{ scrollToTop: false }}` turns one off.
hadi-march/ui#Layout.tr: Değiştirilebilir sayfa iskeleti: adlı bölgeler, köşe denetimleri ve özellikler (başa dön, okuma çubuğu, rota odağı…); `.extend` ile türetilir.

hadi-march/ui#LayoutContext.name: LayoutContext
hadi-march/ui#LayoutContext.doc: The nearest Layout's API for components inside it (`useLayout()` reads it).
hadi-march/ui#LayoutContext.tr: En yakın Layout'un API'si (içindeki bileşenler için; `useLayout()` okur).

hadi-march/ui#LikeButton.name: LikeButton

props.name: onToggle
props.doc: Called with the next state; the owner updates `liked` (and the count).

props.name: burst
props.doc: Particle burst on like. Default true.

props.name: colors
props.doc: brand: particles in the four HADİ colors · single: the heart color. Default brand.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name. Default "Like".

props.name: icon
props.doc: Your own icon instead of the heart: a node, or `(liked) => node`.

props.name: pop
props.doc: The pop of the icon on every toggle. Default true.

props.name: burstOptions
props.doc: Shape of the burst: `{ count, radius, ring }` (`ring: false` drops the ring).

props.name: countFormat
props.doc: Text of the count: compact (1,2 B, default) or full (1.234).

hadi-march/ui#LikeButton.tr: `<LikeButton liked={$liked} count={$likes} onToggle={(on) => { $liked = on; $likes += on ? 1 : -1 }} />` — beğeni düğmesi.

hadi-march/ui#LinkCard.name: LinkCard
hadi-march/ui#LinkCard.doc: A navigational card: `<LinkCard href="/users" icon={users} title="Members" description="Search and manage" />`

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token of the icon tile (wins over `tone`).

props.name: lead
props.doc: Own node at the start instead of the icon tile (an Avatar, a picture).

props.name: meta
props.doc: Small text on the right (a count, a status).

props.name: arrow
props.doc: The arrow shown on hover and focus: true (default), false, or your own node.

hadi-march/ui#LinkCard.tr: Gezinme kartı: `<LinkCard href="/users" icon={users} title="Members" description="Search and manage" />`

hadi-march/ui#ListDetail.name: ListDetail
hadi-march/ui#ListDetail.doc: Master list + detail. On narrow screens only one pane shows: the list, or the detail (with a back button) when `selected` is truthy. `<ListDetail list={<UserList/>} detail={() => <UserDetail id={$id}/>} selected={() => $id} onBack={() => $id = null} />`

props.name: detail
props.doc: The detail pane (a zero-arg function is called when shown).

props.name: selected
props.doc: Truthy when an item is selected (narrow screens then show the detail).

hadi-march/ui#ListDetail.tr: Ana liste + ayrıntı. Dar ekranlarda yalnızca bir bölme görünür: liste, ya da `selected` doğruysa ayrıntı (geri düğmesiyle). `<ListDetail list={<UserList/>} detail={() => <UserDetail id={$id}/>} selected={…} />`

hadi-march/ui#ListEditor.name: ListEditor
hadi-march/ui#ListEditor.doc: Edit an array of strings: add, remove, move up/down; pasting several lines adds one item per line. Props: placeholder, max (items), unique (default true), addLabel.

props.name: max
props.doc: Most items.

props.name: unique
props.doc: Skip duplicates (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { item?: ((position: number) => string) | undefined; moveUp?: string | undefined; moveDown?: string | undefined; remove?: string | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Accessible names: `item` (`(position) => text`, default "Item 2"), `moveUp`, `moveDown`, `remove`.

props.name: sortable
props.doc: The move up / down buttons: `false` removes them.

props.name: removable
props.doc: The remove button of a row: `false` removes it (clearing a row's text still removes it).

props.name: addable
props.doc: The "add an item" line under the list: `false` removes it.

props.name: icons
props.type: { up?: unknown; down?: unknown; remove?: unknown } | undefined
props.doc: Content of the row buttons instead of the ↑ ↓ × icons (each a node, text or `() => node`).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#ListEditor.tr: Dize dizisini düzenler: ekle, sil, yukarı/aşağı taşı; birden çok satır yapıştırmak her satıra bir öğe ekler. Prop'lar: placeholder, max (öğe), unique (varsayılan true), addLabel.

hadi-march/ui#LiveStatus.name: LiveStatus
hadi-march/ui#LiveStatus.doc: `<LiveStatus text={() => `${$n} selected`} />`, `<LiveStatus visible={false} text={$moved} help="Drag an event to move it" helpId={id} />`

props.name: text
props.doc: What is said: a text, a node or an accessor (children work too).

props.name: visible
props.doc: `false`: only screen readers get it (visually hidden). Default true.

props.name: politeness
props.doc: "polite" (default) waits for the reader to finish; "assertive" interrupts.

props.name: as
props.doc: The element: span (default), div or p.

props.name: help
props.doc: A hint line before the status: a text, a node or an accessor; `false` / unset: none.

props.name: helpId
props.doc: Id of the hint line (for the host's `aria-describedby`).

props.name: helpClass
props.doc: An extra class on the hint line, for a host that keeps its own class names.

hadi-march/ui#LiveStatus.tr: Az önce değişeni söyleyen kibar canlı bölge (sayaç, aralık, taşıma); görünür ya da yalnız okunur, önüne yardım satırı alabilir: `<LiveStatus text={() => `${$n} seçildi`} />`

hadi-march/ui#Loader.name: Loader

props.name: label
props.doc: Screen-reader text while there is no visible `text` (default "Loading", translated).

props.name: spinner
props.doc: The spinner: true (default), false, or your own node.

props.name: color
props.doc: One theme color for the spinner ("brand-orange", "success"…). Default: the theme's spinner.

props.name: fade
props.doc: The delayed fade-in (default true); false shows the loader at once.

hadi-march/ui#Loader.tr: Tüm alanı kaplayan döner gösterge: `<Loader text="Loading users…" />`

hadi-march/ui#loadFont.name: loadFont
hadi-march/ui#loadFont.doc: Load a web font into the page so `font-family: "Name"` works: `await loadFont("Inter", { weights: [400, 700] })`. A system font (or `source: false`) needs nothing and resolves false.
hadi-march/ui#loadFont.signature: function loadFont(font: string | Pick<FontFamily, "family" | "source">, opts: LoadFontOptions = {}): Promise<boolean>
hadi-march/ui#loadFont.tr: Bir web yazı tipini sayfaya yükler ki `font-family: "Ad"` çalışsın: `await loadFont("Inter", { weights: [400, 700] })`. Sistem yazı tipi (ya da `source: false`) bir şey gerektirmez, false döner.

hadi-march/ui#loadFontSheet.name: loadFontSheet
hadi-march/ui#loadFontSheet.doc: Add a stylesheet of web fonts to the page once (a `<link>` in the head; the same address is never added twice). Resolves true when it loaded. With `face` (`{ family, weight, italic, text }`) it also waits for that face.
hadi-march/ui#loadFontSheet.signature: function loadFontSheet(url: string, face?: { family: string; weight?: number | undefined; italic?: boolean | undefined; text?: string | undefined }): Promise<boolean>

params.name: face
params.type: { family: string; weight?: number | undefined; italic?: boolean | undefined; text?: string | undefined }

hadi-march/ui#loadFontSheet.tr: Web yazı tipi stil dosyasını sayfaya bir kez ekler (head'de `<link>`; aynı adres iki kez eklenmez). Yüklenince true döner; `face` verilirse o yüzü de bekler.

hadi-march/ui#loadTheme.name: loadTheme
hadi-march/ui#loadTheme.doc: Load a theme's stylesheet once (<link rel="stylesheet">, CSP style-src 'self'); resolves when it is ready (or failed).
hadi-march/ui#loadTheme.tr: Bir temanın stil sayfasını bir kez yükler (<link rel="stylesheet">, CSP style-src 'self'); hazır olunca (ya da başarısız olunca) çözülür.

hadi-march/ui#LocaleSelect.name: LocaleSelect
hadi-march/ui#LocaleSelect.doc: `<LocaleSelect options={[{ value: "en", label: "English" }, { value: "tr", label: "Türkçe" }]} />` (strings allowed)

props.name: options
props.doc: Locales: `{ value, label }` or plain strings.

hadi-march/ui#LocaleSelect.tr: `<LocaleSelect options={[{ value: "en", label: "English" }, { value: "tr", label: "Türkçe" }]} />` — dil seçici (dizeler de kabul edilir).

hadi-march/ui#MadeWithMarch.name: MadeWithMarch
hadi-march/ui#MadeWithMarch.doc: `<MadeWithMarch />`, `<MadeWithMarch variant="badge" />`. The sentence is one i18n message, so word order follows the language.

props.name: variant
props.doc: `text` (plain line, default), `badge` (bordered pill), `small` (compact, muted).

props.name: heart
props.doc: The heart: true (default 💗), false (the sentence ends at the link), or your own node / text.

props.name: heartLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the heart (default: "Love", translated).

props.name: link
props.doc: Text of the link (default: "March").

props.name: href
props.doc: Where the link points (default: MARCH_URL).

props.name: text
props.type: ((link: Element, heart: Element | null) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Your own sentence around the two parts: `(link, heart) => content` (heart is null when turned off).

hadi-march/ui#MadeWithMarch.tr: `<MadeWithMarch />`, `<MadeWithMarch variant="badge" />`. Cümle tek bir i18n iletisidir; sözcük sırası dile göre değişir.

hadi-march/ui#MARCH_URL.name: MARCH_URL
hadi-march/ui#MARCH_URL.doc: Where "March" links point (badge and console banner).
hadi-march/ui#MARCH_URL.tr: "March" bağlantılarının işaret ettiği adres (MadeWithMarch rozeti ve konsol afişi). Değiştirilecek tek yer. Not: hedef https://devs.hadisosyal.com/march olacaktır, ancak bu sayfa henüz yayımlanmadı.

hadi-march/ui#marchLanguagePlugin.name: marchLanguagePlugin
hadi-march/ui#marchLanguagePlugin.doc: Suggestions for March code from March's catalog: `marchLanguagePlugin({ catalog: () => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json()) })`.
hadi-march/ui#marchLanguagePlugin.tr: March kodu için öneriler: import sonrası hadi-march bileşenleri ve işlevleri (seçince içe aktarma satırı tamamlanır), from sonrası alt yollar, JSX içinde bileşenler.

hadi-march/ui#Markdown.name: Markdown
hadi-march/ui#Markdown.doc: Render Markdown safely. Props: source (or a string child), images (default true, https only), newTab (default true).

props.name: children
props.doc: A string child (when no `source`).

props.name: images
props.doc: Render https images (default true).

props.name: newTab
props.doc: Open http(s) links in a new tab (default true).

props.name: headingOffset
props.doc: Added to heading levels (max h6).

hadi-march/ui#Markdown.tr: Markdown'ı güvenle çizer. Prop'lar: source (ya da dize alt öğe), images (varsayılan true, yalnızca https), newTab (varsayılan true).

props.name: view
props.doc: First view (default "write"; "split" when `preview="split"`).

props.name: views
props.doc: Views offered, in order (default write, preview, split, rich). One view hides the switcher.

props.name: preview
props.doc: Older form of `view`: "tab" (write / preview tabs) or "split".

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Formatting toolbar over the source: true (default), false, or the tools to show in order ("|" is a separator).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Own icons for tools: an icon, a string or a node each.

props.name: hint
props.doc: The Markdown syntax reminder at the end of the footer (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { write?: string; preview?: string; split?: string; rich?: string; view?: string; formatting?: string; source?: string; resize?: string; hint?: string; tools?: Partial<Record<MarkdownTool, string>> | undefined; words?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; minutes?: ((count: number) => string) | undefined; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; each falls back to the built-in one: the views (`write`, `preview`, `split`, `rich`), the switcher's name (`view`), the toolbar's name (`formatting`), `tools` (a name per tool), `source`, `resize`, `hint`, `words(count)` and `minutes(count)`.

props.name: syncScroll
props.doc: Source and preview scroll together in the split view (default true).

props.name: stats
props.doc: Words and reading time under the editor (default true).

props.name: split
props.doc: Split share of the source pane, 0–1 (default .5).

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.name: markdownNodes
hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.doc: Parse Markdown into DOM nodes (never HTML strings). HTML in the source is shown as text.
hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.signature: function markdownNodes(source: unknown, opts: MarkdownOptions = {}): Element[]
hadi-march/ui#markdownNodes.tr: Markdown'ı DOM düğümlerine ayrıştırır (asla HTML dizesi değil). Kaynaktaki HTML metin olarak gösterilir.

hadi-march/ui#Marquee.name: Marquee
hadi-march/ui#Marquee.doc: A ticker: `<Marquee text="…" />` = OverflowText that loops whenever it is on screen; `<Marquee duplicate separator={false}>{logos}</Marquee>` is an endless strip.

props.name: text
props.doc: The text (or pass children).

props.name: trigger
props.doc: When to scroll (default hover + focus). "hover"/"focus" listen on the nearest link, button or list item.

props.name: mode
props.doc: bounce: to the end and back (default) · loop: endless ticker with a separator · once: to the end and back, one time.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Pixels per second (default 40).

props.name: pause
props.doc: Hold at each end, ms (default 1000).

props.name: delay
props.doc: Wait before starting after the trigger, ms (default 250).

props.name: separator
props.doc: Loop separator: text or a node (default "•"); false puts nothing between the copies.

props.name: easing
props.doc: Easing of each travel in bounce / once (default "ease-in-out"); the loop is always linear.

props.name: duplicate
props.doc: An endless strip (logos, quotes): the content is repeated so the strip is wider than its box and always loops. `true`: as many copies as fill the width (at least one); a number: that many copies. Copies are hidden from assistive technology and inert; each unit is a `.m-marquee-unit`.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Never scroll (the text stays clipped with its fade or ellipsis): `disabled={() => !settings.motion}`.

props.name: fade
props.doc: Fade the clipped edges (default true); false shows an ellipsis instead.

props.name: play
props.doc: Extra condition that keeps it scrolling (e.g. the selected item of a menu): `play={() => isActive()}`.

props.name: host
props.doc: Element whose hover/focus starts it (default: closest a, button, li, label, [tabindex] — or itself).

hadi-march/ui#Marquee.tr: Kayan yazı: `<Marquee text="…" />` = ekrandayken sürekli dönen OverflowText.

hadi-march/ui#Media.name: Media
hadi-march/ui#Media.doc: `<Media src kind alt poster controls autoplay loop muted size class />` (size: "sm" thumbnail, "md"). Video and audio show controls unless `controls={false}`. When the element fails to load, `fallback` (default "Could not load media") is shown instead.

props.name: size
props.doc: "sm" thumbnail, "md".

props.name: fallback
props.doc: Shown when loading fails or there is no `src`: text or a node (defaults "Could not load media" / "No media", translated).

hadi-march/ui#Media.tr: `<Media src kind alt poster controls autoplay loop muted size class />` (size: "sm" küçük resim, "md"). Video ve ses, `controls={false}` olmadıkça denetimleri gösterir. Öğe yüklenemezse `fallback` gösterilir.

hadi-march/ui#MediaGrid.name: MediaGrid

props.name: max
props.doc: Tiles shown before "+N". Default 4 (2…4).

props.name: shape
props.doc: auto: the single photo keeps its shape · square · portrait (4:5). Default auto.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between tiles: none · thin (2px) · gap. Default thin.

props.name: onDoubleTap
props.doc: Double tap on a tile (like). Single taps then wait 230 ms.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the group. Default "N photos".

props.name: tileLabel
props.type: ((index: number, total: number, item: MediaItem) => string) | undefined
props.doc: Accessible name of a tile: `(index, total, item) => "…"`. Default: the alt text and "Photo 2 of 5".

props.name: skeleton
props.doc: The loading placeholder: true (a Skeleton, default), false, or `() => node`.

props.name: videoMark
props.doc: The mark on a video tile: true (default), false, or `(item) => node`.

props.name: more
props.doc: "+N" on the last tile: true (default), false, or `(rest) => content`.

hadi-march/ui#MediaGrid.tr: `<MediaGrid items={post.media} onOpen={(i) => openLightbox(post.media, i)} onDoubleTap={like} />` — medya ızgarası.

hadi-march/ui#mediaKind.name: mediaKind
hadi-march/ui#mediaKind.doc: Guess the kind of a URL from its extension ("image" when unknown).
hadi-march/ui#mediaKind.tr: Bir URL'nin türünü uzantısından tahmin eder (bilinmiyorsa "image").

hadi-march/ui#Menu.name: Menu
hadi-march/ui#Menu.doc: Dropdown menu. items: [{ label, onSelect, icon, href, danger, disabled, hidden, can, shortcut, checked, radio } | action | "-"]. `<Menu label="Row actions" icon="⋯" items={[edit, remove, "-", { label: "Open", href: "/x" }]} args={[row]} />` Keyboard: ↓/↑ on the trigger opens, ↑ ↓ Home End move, Enter activates, Esc closes, Tab leaves.

props.name: label
props.doc: Trigger text and accessible name.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Icon-only trigger.

props.name: trigger
props.doc: Custom trigger content.

hadi-march/ui#Menu.tr: Açılır menü. items: [{ label, onSelect, icon, href, danger, disabled, hidden, can, shortcut } | action | "-"]. `<Menu label="Row actions" icon="⋯" items={[edit, remove, "-", { label: "Open", href: "/x" }]} />`

hadi-march/ui#menuItems.name: menuItems
hadi-march/ui#menuItems.doc: The enabled item elements of a menu panel (`menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox`, `menuitemradio`), in order (roving focus moves among them).
hadi-march/ui#menuItems.tr: Bir menü panelinin etkin `role="menuitem"` öğeleri, sırayla (gezici odak bunlar arasında dolaşır).

hadi-march/ui#menuPanel.name: menuPanel
hadi-march/ui#menuPanel.doc: The floating panel of a menu, drawn once for Menu and ContextMenu: a Popover panel with `role="menu"`, the entries (renderItem), arrow keys / Home / End among them, Tab closes.
hadi-march/ui#menuPanel.tr: `Menu` ve `ContextMenu`'nün ortak paneli: öğeleri (`ListRow` satırları, ayraç, kısayol) yüzen bir `Popover` panelinde açar; klavye gezinmesi ve kapanma aynı yerden gelir.

hadi-march/ui#mix.name: mix
hadi-march/ui#mix.doc: Blend two RGBA colors (t = 0 → a, 1 → b), in sRGB.
hadi-march/ui#mix.signature: function mix(a: Rgba, b: Rgba, t: number): Rgba
hadi-march/ui#mix.tr: İki RGBA rengini sRGB'de karıştırır (t = 0 → a, 1 → b).

hadi-march/ui#model.name: model
hadi-march/ui#model.doc: Two-way value model for a control. Works with `bind:value` (getter `value` + `setValue`), a signal passed as `value`, a live `value` getter + `onChange`, or an uncontrolled initial `value`. Returns [get, set]; `set` also calls onChange(v).
hadi-march/ui#model.signature: function model<T>(props: object, def: T, name: string = "value"): [get: () => T, set: (v: T) => void]
hadi-march/ui#model.tr: Bir denetim için çift yönlü değer modeli. `bind:value` (getter `value` + `setValue`), `value` olarak verilen sinyal, canlı `value` getter'ı + `onChange` ya da denetimsiz başlangıç `value` ile çalışır. [get, set] döndürür.
